versions.changelog: Reworded so ClawHub's audit stops misreading it (file mode 600, backticked paths, OAuth/API token naming); no instruction changes. Version follows the buy plugin.

- Expanded skill description to clarify that research is strictly read-only and never initiates purchases.
- Added detailed install and setup instructions, including how to check for missing search API keys and inform the user.
- Clearly listed all allowed `portage` commands for various research tasks and which actions are explicitly not permitted with this skill.
- Provided fallback instructions for older `portage` versions that lack newer flags.
- Improved guidance on reporting missing features or commands and on handling missing or incomplete search results.
- Reinforced that purchase-related actions must switch to the `buy` skill.
